description: This pie chart, titled "Distribution of data source in the combined training set," visually represents the proportional contribution of various data sources to a training set, with ten distinct categories shown as colored slices. The largest segment is labeled "NQ" and occupies 31.3% of the chart, colored blue. The second largest is "SNLI" at 15.4%, shown in orange. Following these are "FEVER" at 16.1% (teal), "MULTINLI" at 11.3% (pink), "VITAMINC" at 13.0% (light teal), and "ANLI" at 4.6% (green). Smaller segments include "FACTCC" at 2.6% (orange-red), "ENTFA" at 1.8% (yellow), "SCITAIL" at 1.2% (light green), and "PUBHEALTH" at 0.5% (dark red). The smallest segment, "XSUMHUL," is labeled as 0.1% and appears as a very thin slice, colored light blue. Each slice is clearly labeled with its source name and percentage value, and the chart includes a legend that matches the color of each slice to its corresponding data source. The slices are arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, starting from the largest (NQ) at the top right.
